data.name: Jagadisha
data.gender_notes: Jagadisha is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jagat (universe) + Ish (lord) = Jagadisha (Lord of the Universe). This powerful name is associated with divine kingship, cosmic consciousness, and the supreme ruler of all. The name Jagadisha carries the meaning “Lord of the Universe” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagadisha usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the universe and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes enlightenment, mastery over one's own self, and a deep connection to the universe.
data.etymology: Jagadisha belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Universe.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagadisha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
